correctness.rationale: The exact unobserved A by B rectangle after closed-neighborhood observation yields both directions of the support characterization. Inclusion-exclusion counts all supported labeled subsets, and the connected bipartite exponential formula plus line-graph equivalence counts exactly the connected ones. The minimum placement counts and sharp saturation threshold follow by explicit extremal occupancy. Actual standalone direct-graph enumeration of 107336 subsets across eight graphs agrees with the complete ordinary polynomial; connected recurrence agrees on six graphs. Finite checks are supporting evidence, not the infinite argument.

value.rationale: The natural device-placement invariant is resolved as both complete ordinary and connected polynomials for every rectangular rook graph, with a sharp one-wave forcing rigidity theorem, exact counts of optimal placements, and a sharp cardinality threshold above which failure is impossible. This strictly refines the known scalar optimum and quantifies connectivity costs; it is not a mere rewording or isolated parameter adjustment.
